title: P0.69: Metacognitive Discernment Frame + Genesis Attractor Filter
description: IABV must have a discernment organ before acting. Each datum must pass through a filter that determines origin, reliability, bias, contradictions, grounding, attractors, candidate action, and risk of acting without sufficient evidence.
root_cause: System lacked a unified pre-action discernment contract. Existing services (OSES, ExperimentLab, AdaptiveWeightLayer, PerceptionSnapshot) each held fragments but no service combined them into a coherent frame that could answer: source, confidence, contradictions, bias, and why this action is reasonable.
what_existed: PerceptionSnapshot: unified perception input but no bias/grounding analysis
OSES._neural_attractor_findings(): identifies stable config attractors from experiment runs
OSES._neural_ensemble_findings(): identifies IA pairs that work well together
AdaptiveWeightLayer: adjusts route/assistant weights based on metacognitive feedback
ExperimentLab: compares routes/assistants/configs with real results
StrategySelector: recommends routes by history and evidence
StartupTimeline: phase recorder for boot sequence
what_was_fragmented: No unified contract combining bias detection + grounding + attractors + contradictions
No birth/genesis frame from startup data
No bias filter for external source contradictions vs live state
No human-readable discernment summary for 'me entiendes?' questions
OSES could not detect action_without_grounding or contradiction_ignored patterns
PortableContext did not export discernment state
implemented_tasks: DiscernmentFrameService with build_frame(), build_birth_frame(), bias filter, attractor summary
OSES _discernment_frame_findings(): action_without_grounding, contradiction_ignored, low_confidence_acted_as_high, failed_attractor_repeated, external_source_bias
unresolved: Live Windows proof: verify birth frame generates from real startup_timeline
Live proof: verify discernment question ('me entiendes?') produces correct frame summary
Live proof: OSES finding generated when action taken without grounding
ConceptWeightEvidence integration: no existing ConceptWeightEvidence model found — concept_weights field added to frame but not yet populated from external concept source
TaskContextAssembler integration: requires live test to verify frame summary appears in assembled context
